mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase diazepam plasma concentrations by reducing hepatic metabolism, while diazepam may reduce oral contraceptive efficacy through enzyme induction and enterohepatic circulation effects.
action: Monitor for increased diazepam effects (sedation, CNS depression); consider alternative contraception or diazepam dose adjustment; counsel on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy.
